title: MB Custom Model
description: MB Custom Model defines a custom content type stored in a custom database table. Use it with MB Custom Table to register models via code or import/export from MB Builder.

id.description: Model ID (slug). Must be unique. Used as the first argument of mb_register_model().

name.description: Alias of id. Kept for compatibility with stored model args. Prefer id.

table.description: Custom database table name for the model. Required. Do not add an ID column; the plugin creates it automatically.

labels.description: Labels for the model admin UI. Required.

name.description: General name for the model, usually plural.

singular_name.description: Name for one item of this model.

menu_name.description: Label for the menu name. Default is the same as name.

add_new_item.description: Label for adding a new singular item.

edit_item.description: Label for editing a singular item.

not_found.description: Label used when no items are found.

all_items.description: Label to signify all items in the page title.

item_updated.description: Label used when an item is updated.

item_added.description: Label used when an item is added.

item_deleted.description: Label used when an item is deleted.

show_in_menu.description: Whether to show the model in the admin menu. Optional. Default true.

parent.description: Parent menu slug when the model is a submenu. Optional. Use with show_in_menu set to true.

menu_position.description: The position in the menu where the model should appear. Optional. Used for top-level menus only.

menu_icon.description: Menu icon for top-level menus. Supports Dashicons (dashicons-icon-name), Font Awesome free (fa fa-home), SVG data URI, custom URL, or none.

capability.description: Capability to access the menu and create/edit/delete models. Default edit_posts.

columns.description: Custom table columns. Key is the column name (must match field IDs). Value is the MySQL data type. Do not include the ID column.

additionalProperties.description: MySQL column type, e.g. TEXT, VARCHAR(255), INT, DECIMAL(10,2).

keys.description: Column names to index. Optional. Do not index unrestricted TEXT/BLOB columns without a prefix length.

modified.description: Last modified timestamp. Used by local JSON sync.
